title: Software Engineering Internship (Strategy)
description:
Description

Internship Overview

You won't be running coffee orders or shuffling paperwork this summer. At Fervo, interns are handed something real: a project of your own, scoped with your manager on day one and yours to drive for the full 12 weeks. You'll work side-by-side with the teams building the next generation of geothermal energy, tackling problems that genuinely move the business forward. At the end of the summer, you'll present your work to our executive leadership team, department leads, and fellow interns, sharing real results with a real audience. This is a real seat at the table — and a real shot at what comes next.

Position Description

Fervo Energy is developing next-generation geothermal power to deliver firm, carbon-free energy at scale, anchored by our flagship Cape Station project in Milford, Utah. We're seeking a motivated undergraduate Software Engineer Intern to join our Strategy and AI team, helping build the internal tools and infrastructure that power Fervo's data and AI initiatives.

You'll work alongside our AI and Strategy teams to design, build, and ship software that supports real business needs, gaining hands-on experience with production code rather than toy projects.

Requirements

Responsibilities

Design, build, and maintain internal software tools and applications
Collaborate with the Software Engineering Team to integrate models and data pipelines into usable products
Write clean, well-tested code and participate in code reviews
Support development of internal dashboards, APIs, or automation tools
Troubleshoot and debug issues across the stack

Required Qualifications

Rising Junior or Senior pursuing a Bachelor's degree — we're building a pipeline toward full-time offers
Pursuing a degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field
Strong written and verbal communication skills, including comfort presenting to stakeholders and leadership
Eagerness to learn, take initiative, and adapt quickly to new challenges
Proficiency in at least one modern programming language (e.g., Python, JavaScript, or Java)

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with web frameworks, APIs, or cloud infrastructure (e.g., AWS, Azure)
Familiarity with AI/ML tooling or interest in applied AI
Comfort working in a fast-paced, early-stage engineering environment
note: Fervo Strategy: 'undergraduate Software Engineer Intern', 'Rising Junior or Senior pursuing a Bachelor's degree'. Undergraduate standing language reads as exclusion; nothing on work auth. 'Software Engineer Intern' on a Strategy and AI team, 'this summer', no year named: relevant yes.
